candidates.why: night stroll (free). Kyoto's prettiest street after dark: a willow-lined canal, stone-paved Shinbashi-dōri, wooden teahouses and the little Tatsumi Bridge with Tatsumi Daimyōjin shrine. The glow comes from the teahouse lanterns and street lamps, not an event. Free, always open. (From Plan C, the group's own plan for Tue Dec 22: "Kyoto AM — Fushimi Inari · Kiyomizu · Nishiki → Umeda Santa Parade → Gion night · duck hot-pot · Shirakawa lanterns".)

evidence.note: Chosen by the group for Tue Dec 22: Replaces the NAKED Heian show: no 2026 edition is announced (the last one ran Dec 19 2025 – Jan 18 2026). Pontochō → Shijō bridge → Shirakawa is ~7 min on foot. Free, the group photo spot of Kyoto. Quiet residential teahouses, so keep the volume down, and no photos of geiko/maiko up close. Then walk 10 min back over the river to Kiyamachi.
